title: A short body scan
subtitle: Come back into your body, one place at a time.

steps.body:
A short scan to come back into your body.

We're not looking for anything in particular — just noticing what's already here. If anywhere feels like too much, skip past it. You can stop anytime.
Bring your attention to your feet. Their weight, their temperature, the contact with the floor. Just notice.
Let attention move up — legs, hips, belly, lower back. Nothing to change. Just visit each place, briefly.
Rest at your chest. Feel it rise and fall. A few slow breaths, in their own rhythm.
Hands, shoulders, jaw, the muscles of your face. Let anything that's holding soften a little — or don't. Either is fine.
You're here — in your body, in this room, in this moment. That's the whole practice.

exit.body: However you feel now, you came back to yourself for a few minutes. You can return to this whenever you need it.
